orgs.name: Montana State University — Space Science & Engineering Lab (SSEL)
orgs.research_name: Montana State University - Space Science & Engineering Laboratory (SSEL) / RadPC (LaMeres lab)
orgs.what_they_do: Designs and builds CubeSats (HRBE 2011, FIREBIRD 2013, FIREBIRD II 2015, IT-SPINS, REAL, EXACT, IMPRESS), sounding-rocket solar instruments (MOSES, ESIS, CAPRI-SUN, FURST, ESIS-II), balloon payloads (BOOMS), ISS payloads, and supports RadPC-Lunar. Separately, the ECE lab of Brock LaMeres develops the RadPC radiation-tolerant FPGA computer.
orgs.fit_note: Strong fit. They are repeat suborbital and sounding-rocket users. Pitch: a reusable suborbital ride with intact hardware recovery for instrument and electronics qualification before orbital/lunar flights, e.g. FURST/ESIS-II subsystem pathfinders and RadPC follow-ons.
orgs.keep_reason: Active student-built spaceflight lab with a proven suborbital record: MOSES, ESIS and Hi-C Flare/CAPRI-SUN sounding rockets flown, and FURST and ESIS-II sounding rockets in development. LaMeres' RadPC flew twice on sounding rockets through NASA Flight Opportunities (UP Aerospace SpaceLoft 2014, NASA Terrier-Orion 2016).
